headword: {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}
gloss: freedom of expression; freedom of speech

definitions.gloss: freedom of expression; freedom of speech
definitions.explanation: The right to express ideas, opinions, and information freely through speech, writing, art, and other media. A fundamental right guaranteed by Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution.

examples.japanese: {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}は{憲法|けんぽう}で{保障|ほしょう}されている。
examples.english: Freedom of expression is guaranteed by the constitution.

examples.japanese: {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}にも{限界|げんかい}があるという{意見|いけん}もある。
examples.english: There are also opinions that freedom of expression has its limits.

examples.japanese: この{法案|ほうあん}は{表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}を{侵害|しんがい}するのではないかと{懸念|けねん}されている。
examples.english: There are concerns that this bill may infringe on freedom of expression.

notes:
A fundamental legal and political concept. In Japan, {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう} is protected under {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}{第|だい}21{条|じょう} (Article 21 of the Japanese Constitution), which also guarantees freedom of assembly, association, and the press.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}を{守|まも}る: to protect freedom of expression
- {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}を{侵害|しんがい}する: to infringe on freedom of expression
- {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}が{保障|ほしょう}される: freedom of expression is guaranteed
- {表現|ひょうげん}の{自由|じゆう}の{制限|せいげん}: restrictions on freedom of expression

RELATED WORDS:
- {言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of speech — specifically verbal/written expression
- {報道|ほうどう}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of the press
- {集会|しゅうかい}の{自由|じゆう}: freedom of assembly
- {基本的人権|きほんてきじんけん}: fundamental human rights
